name: Jeeter Liquid Diamond Disposable | Sugar Plum
description:
This sweet and earthy-flavored sativa is truly a treat. With a light body high built for creativity, this strain leaves no limitations on the imagination. With hints of sour notes to round out the trifecta of flavors, this multi-sensory experience is perfect for any night. 

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
